about_the_game:
💠 Cyber Shard Clicker lets you infiltrate and dismantle Vault Inc., a powerful megacorporation. Break enemy firewalls, shatter data defenses, and harness stolen fragments of code to fuel your rise as the ultimate cyber hacker. Progress deeper into the neon net, unlocking new tools, upgrades, and powerful abilities to face Vault’s evolving countermeasures.

Hack, Upgrade, Dominate: The Grid Awaits in Cyber Shard Clicker

🌀 Invest in permanent boosts and abilities, reshaping your strategy for faster infiltration and stronger attacks

⚡Cyber beats and glitch effects to set the mood for your digital assault

⚡ Features:
💻 A Cyberpunk Incremental Hacker Experience – Destroy geometric shapes representing Vault Inc.’s security systems and collect valuable data shards.

🌐 Immersive Neon Aesthetic – Stylish retro-futuristic visuals with a dark hacker vibe.

⚙️ Satisfying Progression System – Unlock upgrades, enhance your clicker efficiency, and push your hacking to new heights.

🌀 Skill Tree – Invest in permanent boosts and abilities, reshaping your strategy for faster infiltration and stronger attacks.

🧩 Strategic Choices – Balance your resources between immediate upgrades and long-term permanent improvements.

📡 Endless Replayability – Every run offers deeper infiltration and tougher corporate defenses to overcome.

🎵 Atmospheric Soundtrack – Cyber beats and glitch effects to set the mood for your digital assault.


🙏 Thank you so much for checking out Cyber Shard Clicker!

I’m a solo indie game developer, and I’m constantly improving the game based on community feedback. By purchasing and playing, you’re supporting my journey to keep creating better and more engaging experiences. Best wishes, and see you in the grid!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows XP/Vista/7/8/10/11
  • Processor: 1.6 GHz Dual Core or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card supporting DirectX 9.0
  • DirectX: Version 9.0a
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Even slower systems run the game.

short_description: Cyber Shard Clicker is a short cyberpunk incremental game. Break down geometric shapes representing hostile cyber attacks against Vault Inc., gather data shards, upgrade your hacking skills, and unlock permanent boosts in the vast skill tree to push your cyber assault even further!
